senses.gloss:
ITA-4.6.7 sañcayaḥ सञ्चयः
Stage of a dosha increasing in its own location
The first stage of disease manifestation, when dosha increases in its own place or site.

ITA-4.8.20 sañcārasthānam सञ्चारस्थानम्
Transit destinations of dosha
Spread or migration of vitiated dosha.

ITA-9.1.64 samjñāprabodhanam संज्ञाप्रबोधनम्
Reviving consciousness
Measures to revive a person from unconsciousness.

ITA-6.2.6.71 saṃjñāsthāpanam संज्ञास्थापनम्
Substance restoring consciousness

ITA-9.7.42 saṁjñā-sthāpanam (viṣopakrama) संज्ञास्थापनम् (विषोपक्रम)
Resuscitation
Therapy or medicines administered to restore consciousness.
